body:
readChannels (src/federation/channel.ts ~317-360 on main; anchor by function name) scans the root ground for channel-record
deltas with NO author or standing check, latest-wins, and defaults every absent or
non-primitive field toward health: receiving !== false, blessing likewise, lastSyncedAt ?? 0,
consecutiveFailures ?? 0. Consequences (T203's erasure lens, 2026-08-21):
1. Any writer with standing can append a newer channel-shaped record and override a real
   channel's toggles on every reader (list, panel, MCP).
2. A partially-legible record renders healthy-never-synced, indistinguishable from a real
   quiet channel. (The NaN crash is already guarded at the admin panel — the READER is the
   remaining hole.)

Build: (a) filter channel records by lawful author — the operator's records govern channels,
matching how the record is written (openChannelImpl signs as the operator); a non-operator
record is not a channel record. (b) A record whose fields fail their shapes yields an
UNREADABLE marker at the reader level, never a healthy default — every consumer then tells
the truth for free. Shape constraint from the frozen T203 rail
(test/server/admin-channel-health.test.ts ~449-454): channelStatus must still RETURN the row
with the corrupt field NaN in place and the sibling finite — so unreadability is an ADDITIVE
marker on the existing ChannelStatus shape, never a replacement or a dropped row.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) A non-operator channel-shaped delta newer than the real record changes nothing in
    readChannels' answer (two-sided: the real record still reads). Verify: new test
    test/federation/channel-record-trust.test.ts.
(b) A record with a non-numeric lastSyncedAt yields the unreadable shape at the reader, and
    `loam federate list` + the admin panel + loam_federate_status all render it as such.
    Verify: same file plus one assertion per surface (admin-channel-health.test.ts and
    drop-cli.test.ts are frozen — new files there; federate-mcp.test.ts is NOT frozen and may
    be extended).

Merge tier: repair — the reader stops trusting what the door never promised. Self-merge on
the ordinary bar.
title: readChannels defaults toward health and filters by no author — a forged or partial record reads as a healthy channel
